subStrands.name: Scientific Method and Classification of Matter

objectives.description: Describe the nature and importance of science and apply the scientific method to simple investigations
Measure physical quantities (length, mass, volume, time) using appropriate instruments and SI units
Classify matter into solids, liquids, and gases based on observable properties and explain changes of state
Distinguish between elements, compounds, and mixtures and describe their properties
Describe atoms and molecules as the basic building blocks of matter and use chemical symbols
Separate mixtures using appropriate methods (filtration, evaporation, distillation, sieving)
Identify the properties and uses of acids, bases, and salts in everyday life
Distinguish between living and non-living things using observable characteristics
Describe the cell as the basic unit of life and identify the parts of plant and animal cells
Explain the functions of the respiratory, digestive, and circulatory systems in the human body
Describe reproduction in flowering plants and explain the process of photosynthesis
Describe the properties, composition, and importance of soil to agriculture
Classify living organisms into major groups and identify distinguishing features of each group

subStrands.name: Forms, Transfer, and Transformation of Energy

objectives.description: Identify forms of energy (heat, light, sound, electrical, mechanical, nuclear) and give examples of energy sources
Explain heat transfer by conduction, convection, and radiation with practical examples
Describe how sound is produced, transmitted through different media, and its everyday uses and dangers
Explain reflection and refraction of light and describe uses of lenses and mirrors
Describe electric current, voltage, conductors, insulators, and simple series and parallel circuits
Define force, friction, gravity, and simple machines and explain their effects in daily life
Describe natural and artificial magnets, their properties, and uses including electromagnets
Explain work, energy, and power and the relationship between them using simple calculations

subStrands.name: Climate, Technology, and Careers in Science

objectives.description: Explain the causes, effects, and mitigation strategies for climate change
Describe the role of ICT, robotics, nanotechnology, and artificial intelligence in modern science
Identify career opportunities in science and their relevance to national development
Conduct simple science experiments safely and record results accurately
